source.label: Real data
source.description: 205 cardiologists in the eight cities whose 2024 Medicare billing is mostly in hospital settings, from public CMS records. Same ten signals as Synthetic, but none has a real source connected, so all are empty and nothing is scored.

provenance.identity: real (CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners, by Provider, 2024)
provenance.hospital-based: inferred from 2024 billing setting (at most 20% of services in office settings)
provenance.signals: none connected; all ten are empty

universe.rule: Billing city is one of the eight cities, and at most 20% of the physician's 2024 Medicare services were billed in an office setting.
caveats: "Hospital-based" is inferred from where services were billed, not from employment records. A hospital-employed physician can bill in an office, and an independent one in a hospital.
The share uses the service lines CMS publishes; lines with fewer than 11 patients are suppressed.
Medicare only: physicians with no published Medicare services aren't listed.
City means the billing address city exactly; suburbs of the same metro aren't included.
sources: CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners, by Provider (2024)
CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners, by Provider and Service (2024)

prediction.why: No signal has a real source connected, so there is nothing to weight or score. There is also no real outcome data (who actually left hospital employment), so nothing could be validated. Score, ranking, timing windows and candidate groups are left blank rather than estimated.

signals.label: Employer disruption
signals.rationale: Employer M&A, financial distress, or layoffs is the single biggest real-world trigger for a physician to leave. The signal decays as the event recedes.
signals.definition: exp(-months_since_event / 12); 0 when the employer has no event
signals.missing: Needs news or filings about the physician's employer (M&A, financial distress, layoffs). No news or M&A source is connected, and the employer itself is unknown: CMS hospital-affiliation data refused this client (403).
signals.productionSource: M&A / distress news and filings — not connected (not attempted).

signals.label: Career stage
signals.rationale: The ~10-22 year sweet spot: established enough to carry a book of business, early enough to want to build something.
signals.missing: Needs years in practice (training-completion or board-certification year). CMS Doctors & Clinicians, which lists graduation year, refused this client (403); no other source is connected.
signals.productionSource: NPPES enumeration date or board-certification year — not connected (not attempted).

signals.label: Prior independent
signals.rationale: Has practiced independently before -- dramatically lower friction to do it again.
signals.definition: 1 if any prior independent affiliation, else 0
signals.missing: Needs the physician's past practice affiliations. CMS Doctors & Clinicians archives refused this client (403) and PECOS history was not attempted.
signals.productionSource: Past group affiliations (CMS Doctors & Clinicians archives; PECOS) — not connected. The Doctors & Clinicians endpoints returned 403 from this environment.

signals.label: Subspecialty economics
signals.rationale: Procedure-heavy subspecialties (interventional, EP) sustain independent economics; advanced heart failure is hospital-dependent.
signals.definition: lookup: Interventional 1.00, EP 0.95, Imaging 0.65, General cardiology 0.60, AHF 0.35
signals.missing: The subspecialty is real (Medicare provider type), but this signal turns it into an economics score with a fixed lookup (Interventional 1.00 … Advanced heart failure 0.35). That lookup is an assumption, not data, so the signal is left empty.
signals.productionSource: NPI taxonomy (subspecialty) with a fixed economics lookup. The subspecialty is real in Real-identities mode (NIH/NLM registry); the lookup values are an assumption. Simulated in Synthetic mode.

signals.label: Productivity (wRVU)
signals.rationale: High work-RVU producers can sustain a practice of their own.
signals.missing: Needs work RVUs. Medicare allowed amounts are published but are Medicare-only and are not wRVUs; using them as a stand-in was declined.
signals.productionSource: Work RVUs (internal productivity data) — not connected. CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners publishes Medicare-only allowed amounts, which are not wRVUs.

signals.label: Peer recently left
signals.rationale: A local colleague who just went independent is powerful social proof and opens the window now.
signals.definition: 1 if a same-metro peer changed to an independent affiliation recently
signals.missing: Needs to know which colleagues left to go independent (affiliation history). Only Medicare billing addresses are available, and an address change doesn't show who went independent; that stand-in was declined.
signals.productionSource: Affiliation changes over time (CMS Doctors & Clinicians archives) — not connected; returned 403 from this environment.

signals.label: Local independent density
signals.rationale: An existing independent ecosystem supplies referral and operational scaffolding.
signals.definition: independent cardiology groups in metro / 8 (capped at 1)
signals.missing: Needs a count of independent cardiology groups in the metro. CMS Doctors & Clinicians group data refused this client (403). Office-setting billing sites don't prove independence, so they weren't used.
signals.productionSource: Independent cardiology group counts (CMS Doctors & Clinicians) — not connected; returned 403 from this environment.

signals.label: Recent employer change
signals.rationale: Recently moved -- already in motion and more open to another change.
signals.missing: Needs employment or reassignment history (PECOS, not attempted). A Medicare billing-address change isn't an employer change; that stand-in was declined.
signals.productionSource: CMS PECOS reassignment records — not connected (not attempted).

signals.label: Contract window
signals.rationale: A contract renewal is a natural decision point.
signals.missing: Needs employment-contract renewal dates, which aren't public.
signals.productionSource: Not public — would come from relationship conversations.

signals.label: Industry engagement
signals.rationale: Industry engagement is a proxy for an entrepreneurial posture.
signals.missing: Needs CMS Open Payments. Its query API refused this client (403).
signals.productionSource: CMS Open Payments — not connected; its query API returned 403 from this environment.
